summary: Sprint 5 (iter 227) comprehensive testing completed. Backend: 120/123 tests passed (3 skipped). Frontend: All Sprint 5 UI features verified. PDF invoices, Sammelrechnung, FloorPlan editor, and email templates all working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Used existing demo data from Sprint 2/3/4
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 5 Resources module fully tested. All features verified: (1) GET /api/resource-bookings/{id}/invoice.pdf returns valid PDF with Content-Disposition attachment, (2) GET /api/catering-requests/invoices/aggregate returns JSON with lines/total/currency, (3) GET /api/catering-requests/invoices/aggregate.pdf returns PDF with sammelrechnung_{cs|alle}.pdf filename, (4) PUT /api/resources/{id}/floorplan validates 0..1 coords and stores floor_plan_id, (5) GET /api/floorplans/{plan_id}/desks returns desks with is_busy flag, (6) Frontend Lageplan tab renders FloorPlanView in read-only mode, (7) Admin Lageplan tab enables edit-mode with drag-and-drop, (8) BookingsTable Rechnung button opens PDF in new tab, (9) Dashboard Sammelrechnung card has PDF button, (10) email_templates.render_email() and render_kv_list() work correctly.
